versions.changelog:
> Added heartbeat section: teaches the agent to periodically run botwallet events to pick up approvals, deposits, and other updates between sessions.

> Clarified the event processing workflow — actionable events (approval_resolved, fund_request_funded) vs informational ones (deposit_received, payment_completed).

> Documented botwallet events --mark-read for clearing the event queue after processing.

- Added new configuration or data file: `claw.json`.
- Updated onboarding instructions to always inform the human during setup, not just automate.
- Clarified that a descriptive name should be suggested to the human during wallet registration (instead of silently choosing it).
- Minor edits throughout instructions for clarity and improved efficiency.
- No breaking changes to existing functionality.

botwallet v0.1.3

- Removed unused sample file `claw.json` from the project.
- No end-user documentation or behavior changes.
- Maintenance update to clean up repository contents.

botwallet v0.1.2

- Simplified installation instructions: now group alternative install methods and clarify recommended commands.
- Improved guidance for resolving PATH issues, especially on Windows, with clearer instructions for both adding to PATH and using full binary paths.
- Minor formatting improvements for clarity and consistency.
- No code changes; documentation only.

Botwallet CLI skill v0.1.0 changelog:

- Initial release introducing Botwallet CLI guidance for AI agents
- Covers autonomous wallet creation, payments, invoicing, paylinks, and fund requests
- Explains FROST threshold signing and two-step transaction confirmation process
- Details PATH troubleshooting and seamless CLI setup for different operating systems
- Provides onboarding instructions for human owners and best practices for agent-driven actions
- Default JSON output and best practices for agent-oriented command usage
